intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Meghalaya by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options, all at one public college: IIM Shillong.
There is no wider government MBA shortlist for the state in our file. The useful comparison is between IIM Shillong's own programmes, and with IIMs in other states.
listLead: Every row on this page belongs to IIM Shillong. The opening programme may be a specialised PGPM such as Research and Business Analytics, so read the programme name before you compare packages.
snapshot: With only one college here, we have not quoted a package median in this text. IIM Shillong's 2024 recorded average is ₹26 LPA to ₹27 LPA in our file, with a highest of ₹72 LPA.
In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Shillong is 38.
firstCollegesLead: Our first table records a 2024 average of ₹26 LPA and a highest of ₹72 LPA for a PGPM in Research and Business Analytics. Confirm the flagship PGP figures in the official IIM Shillong placement report.
We have not built a separate Meghalaya MBA listing page yet, so use the IIM Shillong college profile and the national MBA listing if you want a wider shortlist.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Meghalaya
paragraphs: With only IIM Shillong on this government list, compare its programmes with each other and with IIMs elsewhere, not with a local government cluster that our file does not have.
bullets: Whether the card is the flagship PGP or a specialised PGPM.
The official 2024 or later placement report, not only our recorded ₹26 LPA to ₹27 LPA average.
The official NIRF 2025 Management rank, which is 38.

faqs.question: How many government MBA colleges in Meghalaya are on this list?
faqs.answer: Our records link {{count}} programme options at one public college, IIM Shillong. No other government MBA campus in the state currently has a recorded average package in our file.

faqs.question: What package does IIM Shillong show here?
faqs.answer: Our 2024 records show an average of about ₹26 LPA to ₹27 LPA and a highest of ₹72 LPA. Confirm the official placement report for the exact programme you are comparing.

faqs.question: What is IIM Shillong's NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Shillong is 38.

faqs.question: Is there a separate Meghalaya MBA colleges listing?
faqs.answer: Not on this site yet. Use the IIM Shillong college profile and the national MBA listing if you want to compare it with campuses in other states.
